impacts.text: Late bonding allows attackers to dilute rewards for honest participants.
Despite Alice participating for the entire epoch, Bob captures the majority of rewards after bonding only seconds before epoch close.

ambiguities: Attacker receives a majority of emissions despite participating briefly (e_e3728821b991_0022)
Attacker captures a disproportionate share of emissions while only participating for a negligible portion of the epoch (e_e3728821b991_0006)
